newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 19.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Three Frenchmen out of four see far-right party National Front as a threat to democracy, survey shows.
-- Worries about a possible delay of EMU trigger tension on financial markets.
-- Credit Lyonnais chairman Jean Peyrelevade told Parliament's finance committee yesterday that he estimates losses linked to assets transferred to CDR holding company at around 100 billion francs.
-- Societe Marseillaise de Credit prepares restructuring plan for 1997 in view of its privatisation.
-- Carrefour chairman Daniel Bernard said he would help French small and medium-sized firms export, notably in Latin America through its supermarkets.
